pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with jagged, high-frequency edge gradients. Patches on the upper flank exhibit higher spatial area compared to the smaller, more fragmented shapes visible on the lower hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Lattice of light-colored negative space with tri-radial junction nodes. Pathways maintain relatively consistent pixel thickness on the upper mid-flank, becoming thinner and more complex toward the ventral and posterior regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the neck-to-shoulder transition showing a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct horizontal linear mark or physical indentation is visible on the mid-flank, disrupting the continuity of the pelage pattern across multiple patches.
